<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.3.18</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.3.18">Released</a> on July 04, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>Mesheryctl
<ul>
<li><code>mesheryctl version</code> now retrieves server version information, including release tag and git sha.</li>
<li><code>meshery perf</code> now supports SPMS as a package through the <code>--file</code> flag.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Meshery
<ul>
<li>Extensibility enhancement: an abstract interface, Load Generator Interface, is now provided for ease of extending Meshery to support other load generators, like Nighthawk.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Docs
<ul>
<li>uplifted EKS and GKE instructions</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        document.querySelectorAll("#logo-dark-light").forEach(e => {
          e.src = e.dataset.logoForLight;
        });

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }

        })
    });

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.3.5</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.3.5">Released</a> on January 13, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>Mesheryctl
<ul>
<li>Removal of <code>init</code> as a command exposed to users. This command&rsquo;s functionality is used internal to <code>mesheryctl start</code>. A new <code>start --check</code> command will provide preflight check functionality in <code>init</code>&rsquo;s place.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.3.6</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.3.6">Released</a> on January 14, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">

</h3>
<ul>
<li>Mesheryctl
<ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.3.7</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.3.7">Released</a> on January 15, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>Meshery Server
<ul>
<li>Ad-hoc connectivity tests for Prometheus is now supported. Users can click the Prometheus chip and have Meshery verify its ability to connect to the configured Prometheus instance.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.3.9</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.3.9">Released</a> on February 02, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>Mesheryctl
<ul>
<li>Addition of <code>mesheryctl version</code> to provide server-side version number.</li>
<li>Improvement of <code>mesheryctl logs | stop | start</code> to provide appropriate grammar in situations when Meshery is stopped or Docker is not present.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Meshery Server
<ul>
<li>Strip off extraneous information beyond IP address and port in Grafana and Prometheus endpoints (<a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/issues/612">#612</a>)</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.4.0-beta.2</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.0-beta.2">Released</a> on July 08, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>Meshery
<ul>
<li>Added initial kubeconfig.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Mesheryctl
<ul>
<li>Removed fatal error due to missing <code>meshery.yaml</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Documentation
<ul>
<li>Updated Kuma adapter logo in Meshery Docs.</li>
<li>Added network ports to the adapters table.</li>
<li>Added providers screenshot.</li>
<li>Added all supported platforms to list.</li>
<li>Added nighthawk as a load generator.</li>
<li>Fixed broken link in EKS page.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.4.10</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.10">Released</a> on October 03, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>General</p>
<ul>
<li>fix: go modules conflicts generated by dependabot @kushthedude (#1627)</li>
<li>Updated the UI for the preferences section @Nikhil-Ladha (#1632)</li>
<li>Add Meshery Release v0.4.2 to Release page @KarenEfereyan (#1630)</li>
<li>SMI table Tweaks @dhruv0000 (#1624)
Conforming to Navigation Conformances @dhruv0000 (#1618)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Maintenance</p>
<ul>
<li>Bump github.com/sirupsen/logrus from 1.6.0 to 1.7.0 @dependabot-preview (#1621)</li>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.31.1 to 1.32.0 @dependabot-preview (#1623)</li>
<li>Bump fortio.org/fortio from 1.6.8 to 1.8.1 @dependabot-preview (#1620)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.13.0 to 0.14.0 @dependabot-preview (#1622)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Documentation</p>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Updated adapter docs @chandrashritii (#1614)</li>
<li>update meshery architecture diagrams @lolyparty (#1619)</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.4.14</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.14">Released</a> on October 20, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>General</p>
<ul>
<li>Translate contribute guide to docs to spanish @jesuslerma (#1696)</li>
<li>security: update ui deps to avoid DOS @kushthedude (#1689)</li>
<li>fix(UI): table filters not rendering due to custom header @dhruv0000 (#1694)</li>
<li>Updating Istio Documentation, @Maxgit3 (#1683)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.4.15</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.15">Released</a> on October 23, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>General</p>
<ul>
<li>Trying to get the signoff check this time @alonsolopezr (#1724)</li>
<li>Added SMP Logo in ReadMe @Aarush-Goyal (#1648)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl]Attempt to start docker daemon during mesheryctl installation @hexxdump (#1685)</li>
<li>Changed lifecycle method for props update @dhruv0000 (#1722)</li>
<li>fix(UI): Persist Grafana charts after a Reloading @dhruv0000 (#1721)</li>
<li>[Adapter] Remove NGINX SM Adapter from Stable release channel pending adapter beta release @leecalcote (#1714)</li>
<li>Add experimental subcommand to mesheryctl @anirudhjain75 (#1715)</li>
<li>nginx adapter changes without the svgs @kumarabd (#1705)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] #1708 version command add indicator to user @cardinalion (#1710)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Fix command provides invalid upgrade prompt #1707 @cardinalion (#1709)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Features</p>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] feature update @chandrashritii (#1719)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Documentation</p>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] feature update @chandrashritii (#1719)</li>
</ul>
</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.4.16</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.16">Released</a> on October 28, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>General</p>
<ul>
<li>Minor correction of words in the kinD quick start page @alonsolopezr (#1759)</li>
<li>fix: remove the duplicate function required for version checking @kushthedude (#1767)</li>
<li>Getting the gke quick start page, translation to es in the docs-pages… @alonsolopezr (#1757)</li>
<li>[Docs] Translate Project page to Spanish @homero304 (#1740)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Add prerequisite on docker daemon running status @hexxdump (#1746)</li>
<li>Add latest available version in the API and in the dashboard @utkarsh-pro (#1761)</li>
<li>enh: populate loadGenerator in SMP results @kushthedude (#1765)</li>
<li>[ImgBot] Optimize images @IMGBOT (#1764)</li>
<li>[Docs] Section update @chandrashritii (#1726)</li>
<li>[Docs] fixes #1748 SVG of Meshery Architecture Diagram @DanRowe1 (#1760)</li>
<li>Updated WSL link Signed-off-by: Bart Kalanski <a href="mailto:bkalanski@gmail.com">bkalanski@gmail.com</a> @bartkalanski (#1755)</li>
<li>Getting the docker quick start page, translation to es in the docs-pa… @alonsolopezr (#1744)</li>
<li>Getting the aks quick start page, translation to es in the docs/pages… @alonsolopezr (#1741)</li>
<li>Getting the eks quick start page, translation to es in the docs-pages… @alonsolopezr (#1743)</li>
<li>[UI] update nginx-sm logo @leecalcote (#1750)</li>
<li>fixes for remote provider @kumarabd (#1739)</li>
<li>[Docs] README - Add NGINX Service Mesh adapter @UnkleTayo (#1736)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h3 id="whats-new">

</h3>
<ul>

<ul>
<li>Translation of the kubernetes quick start pageto es, just added this … @alonsolopezr (#1774)</li>

<li>[Docs] update resources page @chandrashritii (#1771)</li>
<li>Bump the chart version and add mesheryconsul adapter @Aisuko (#1781)</li>
<li>[provider-ui] - Add Integration test for Provider UI @ramrodo (#1778)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Bug Fixes</p>
<ul>

</ul>
</li>
<li>

<ul>
<li>[Docs] Architecture diagrams @leecalcote (#1783)</li>
</ul>
</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.4.18</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.18">Released</a> on November 08, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>General</p>
<ul>
<li>Updated version.go @tripathyprateek (#1866)</li>
<li>[UI] Istio control plane addition to the dashboard @utkarsh-pro (#1868)</li>
<li>Fixed Broken Link in README @Yashs911 (#1878)</li>
<li>ui: updated side-nav @chebro (#1867)</li>
<li>fix: meshery helm chart notes are invalid @kushthedude (#1870)</li>
<li>[ImgBot] Optimize images @IMGBOT (#1873)</li>
<li>[Docs] feature-guide-update @chandrashritii (#1869)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Read user consent before starting Docker daemon in PreReqCheck @hexxdump (#1859)</li>
<li>Add mesh names derived from SMP spec @utkarsh-pro (#1858)</li>
<li>chore: add html next.js headers @kushthedude (#1864)</li>
<li>[Docs] Fix search plugin @chandrashritii (#1839)</li>
<li>[UI] Add test integration for /userpreference @ramrodo (#1853)</li>
<li>Reordered service mesh names in Management sub-menu @ayushk1804 (#1851)</li>
<li>translate of the platform page to spanish @alonsolopezr (#1809)</li>
<li>[Docs] fix broken link @chandrashritii (#1840)</li>
<li>Traducción Instalación en windows @jeojhx (#1790)</li>
<li>Chore: change release drafter token to use personal pat @karleypetracca (#1807)</li>
<li>Add alphabetical sorting to the Adapter Operation lists @utkarsh-pro (#1806)</li>
<li>feat: add lint staged @Tanuj22 (#1805)</li>
<li>chore: restore nginx-adapter in compose.yaml @kushthedude (#1796)</li>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.4.19</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.19">Released</a> on November 10, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>General</p>
<ul>
<li>Add meshery-kuma @Aisuko (#1854)</li>
<li>Add the meshery-osm chart @Aisuko (#1802)</li>
<li>Add support for linkerd in the dashboard service mesh view @utkarsh-pro (#1881)</li>
<li>Add permission to watch the nodes @Aisuko (#1893)</li>
<li>add shell completion command @WLun001 (#1877)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Bug Fixes</p>
<ul>
<li>fix: bash script to utilise dynamic input @kushthedude (#1875)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Maintenance</p>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Add e2e test for /userpreference @ramrodo (#1862)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Documentation</p>
<ul>
<li>Docs: add AKS installation instructions for Meshery @kushthedude (#1871)</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.4.2</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.2">Released</a> on August 17, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s new?
</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Features</p>
<ul>
<li>Update CRUD operations on test config</li>
<li>Fix for unwanted snackbar in perf preferences tab</li>
<li>Add validation for protocol in URL</li>
<li>Initialize OSM adapter for Meshery</li>
<li>Add new command restart to mesheryctl</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Maintenance</p>
<ul>
<li>Fix broken ci for ui tests</li>
<li>Optimize images</li>
<li>Remove redundant step from docker push</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Documentation</p>
<ul>
<li>Remove broken links from table of supported platforms</li>
<li>Remove example of brew upgrade mesheryctl output</li>
<li>Create smi-conformance-capability.md file</li>
<li>Fix documentation site broken links</li>
<li>Fix broken link to SMP in release.md</li>
<li>Upgrade Meshery Kuma Adapter to beta</li>
<li>Update adapter docs</li>
<li>Add logos to assets folder</li>
<li>Add Open Service Mesh to list</li>
<li>Fix typo error in App Mesh Adapter description</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Bug Fixes</p>
<ul>
<li>Create/Delete/Read on user test profiles</li>
<li>Fix for the results page</li>
<li>Fix releaseDrafter configuration file</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
